name: tests-75pct-bubbles-terminal-safe-untrusted-content-rendering
instr:
Bubbles cannot currently present untrusted text without allowing it to alter terminal state. Introduce a uniform opt-in policy that separates projected display text from logical source values, preserving existing interaction, identity, and editing semantics. Components without an explicit policy must preserve current behavior.

`contentpolicy.Default` selects deterministic pass-through or terminal-safe projection. `contentpolicy.Policy.Apply` returns inert display text with classified findings for all controls, escape sequences, incomplete sequences, and line boundaries without panicking. `contentpolicy.Result.DisplayOffset` and `contentpolicy.Result.SourceOffset` provide monotonic bidirectional boundary mappings across removed spans and multibyte text. Trusted component styling remains effective around projected text, while untrusted content cannot move the cursor or change terminal state.

Policy-aware geometry governs measurement, truncation, wrapping, highlighting, scrolling, cursors, and selections. Stored values and identities remain original. `viewport.WithContentPolicy`, `viewport.Model.SetContentPolicy`, `table.WithContentPolicy`, `table.Model.SetContentPolicy`, `tree.Model.SetContentPolicy`, `filepicker.Model.SetContentPolicy`, `textinput.Model.SetContentPolicy`, `textarea.Model.SetContentPolicy`, `key.Binding.SetContentPolicy`, `help.Model.SetContentPolicy`, and `list.Model.SetContentPolicy` apply this throughout their render paths and embedded children.
